explanation.scene_replacement: Preservar a festa e substituir somente a pessoa escolhida exige edição localizada, máscara e consistência temporal.
explanation.motion_transfer: Reproduzir a coreografia com uma personagem, permitindo reconstruir o cenário, favorece modelos de transferência direta de movimento.
explanation.multi_scene_replacement: Várias pessoas exigem associação de identidades, rastreamento individual, máscaras e resolução de oclusões.

notes: Empirical video check (2026-11-14): Flow Omni Flash 1.2 produced 15s 360p 24fps with five characters in a newly choreographed arrangement, not the source dancers' exact movements/locations. Flow remains available as a creative reinterpretation tool and manual preparator, but is excluded from strict scene-preserving auto-routing. 1-4: evaluate Openjutsu/Wan with masks and pose; no verified free GPU. 5: no compatible validated one-pass option; staged character passes and compositing required. Zero payment/no auto submission preserved.
